_comment: Qualifiers CodeWarrior's DWARF v1 does not record (volatile is never emitted). Each entry is inferred from codegen; see writeup.md. Applied by tools/dwarftypes.py.
_comment_const: Global variables in .rodata: DWARF v1 does not record const either.
_comment_externs: Correct shared declarations inferred from defining units and access patterns. checkpoint.c defines ghostRaceTimes as six floats (24 bytes); its finish_cam accesses require an unsized extern array to preserve original HA/LO addressing rather than inferred small-data addressing.
_comment_prototypes: Declarations the original headers used where they differ from the definition recorded in DWARF (callers pass extra/differently-typed arguments). Inferred from call sites.
